items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Alton Red was the leader and Marshall Royal was the saxophone player and I was the piano player.

ctx.x: We worked in San Pedro. We worked a little club in San Pedro. Alton Red was the leader and Marshall Royal was the saxophone player and I was the piano player. Three pieces.
